_about: Five lab test cases. Cases 1-4 are Whisper-style transcripts (no speaker labels, run-on lines, mishearings) sent to the note-drafting model with the app's own prompt. Case 5 is the Step 2 ranking with stale, thin data. All people and numbers are made up.

lines: Okay so we're recording, you good with that? Yeah that's fine. Alright, so tell me your name for the file. Darius Johnson. D-A-R-I-U-S.
And how old are you Darius? Forty one. I'll be forty two in March.
Where are you staying right now? I'm at my sister's in Inglewood, off 63rd and Halsted, on her couch. She said I can stay till the end of the month but after that I don't know.
Okay. When did you come home? Last Thursday. I came out of Stateville, did six years. And you're on MSR? Yeah, two years MSR, my parole agent is a Miss Ortiz, I see her the 19th.
What's the best number for you? 773 555 0148. That's my sister's phone though, I ain't got one yet.

What about ID, you got your state ID? No, they gave me the release papers and that's it, I lost my old ID before I went in. Okay, I'm going to take you to the Secretary of State on King Drive Friday morning, we'll get that started.
And medical? I'm on blood pressure pills, they gave me like ten days worth. You got a doctor? No. Okay we need to get you on Medicaid then.
Work? I got my forklift certificate inside, I want to get on at a warehouse. Okay, we'll talk about that once the ID's done. Alright. Anything else? Nah that's it for now.

Age 41, heard (turning 42 in March is not a conflict)

Needs: state ID; health insurance / Medicaid; blood pressure medication and a doctor (Soon, 10 days, not Urgent); housing after end of month (Soon); job at a warehouse (Later)
